implementation_context.boundary: Visual specification only. Existing Shopify/Lumia selection, variant, fitment, cart, pricing, wishlist, carousel and product-card behavior remains authoritative unless the implementation agent verifies a visual requirement cannot be achieved by reuse, restyling, or extension.

reference_geometry.note: Measurements are inferred from the supplied raster reference and should be treated as implementation targets rather than source-design dimensions.

visual_invariants: Wheel/product image is the dominant visual element.
Card reads as one premium light-surface commerce unit with restrained rounding and subtle elevation.
Information hierarchy is media → taxonomy/title → rating → price → swatches → optional attributes → primary CTA → secondary action.
Typography is predominantly black/dark charcoal on white, with compact uppercase tracking used for technical labels/actions.
Primary CTA is visually dominant over View Details.
Optional or unavailable data must collapse cleanly without leaving empty vertical gaps.
Native Shopify/Lumia functional behavior remains authoritative; this specification governs presentation.

card_container.border: No prominent stroke; edge definition comes primarily from light shadow/contrast.

shadow.value: soft, low-opacity, diffuse shadow; approximately 0 2px 12-18px rgba(0,0,0,0.06-0.10)

card_container.vertical_rhythm: Compact, consistent 8-14px gaps; stronger separation before feature row and CTA.

product_media.prominence: Product occupies roughly 80-90% of the usable main-media width and remains visually dominant.
product_media.separation: No heavy divider between main media and thumbnails; separation is achieved through spacing and thumbnail boundaries.

thumbnail_rail.selected_state: thin dark outline around active thumbnail
thumbnail_rail.dependency: CONDITIONAL; render only when compatible gallery/alternate media behavior is available.

product_badge.relationship_to_image: overlays unused top-left image whitespace without covering the wheel
product_badge.data_rule: CONDITIONAL; driven by product data, metafield, tag mapping, or verified theme configuration.

wishlist.radius: not visually expressed in default state

hover_focus.value: visible hover/focus feedback without moving control

selected.value: filled or otherwise clearly active heart using existing Lumia wishlist semantics

wishlist.dependency: Implementation agent must verify existing Lumia wishlist markup, app integration, and state classes.

taxonomy.dependency: CONDITIONAL; source must be verified (product type, collection, tag, metafield, or theme mapping).

overflow.value: allow up to two lines in reusable contexts; preserve equal-card layout through existing theme strategy where applicable

rating.stars: five compact gold stars; reference visually shows a partial/less-prominent fifth state consistent with 4.7
rating.dependency: Do not synthesize ratings. Implementation agent must verify Lumia rating snippet and product review/metafield source.

normal.secondary: '/ wheel' at approximately 14-16px, regular weight, muted dark gray

sale_state.value: preserve native Shopify sale-price semantics; sale price remains primary and compare-at price becomes subordinate/struck-through without disrupting hierarchy

compare_at_state.value: use existing Lumia/Shopify compare-at rendering when present

price.unit_suffix_dependency: Implementation agent must verify whether '/ wheel' is globally valid, product-specific, or theme-configured before rendering.

swatches.border: subtle 1px neutral border where needed for contrast

selected_state.value: clear ring/outline or existing Lumia selected-state treatment

swatches.overflow_indicator: plain '+N' text after visible swatches; reference shows +2
swatches.relationship_to_price: directly below price with compact spacing
swatches.boundary: Visual treatment only; do not redefine Lumia variant-selection architecture.
swatches.dependency: Implementation agent must verify swatch source, variant option naming, swatch assets/colors, and interaction behavior.

feature_row.column_separators: thin light-gray vertical rules between columns
feature_row.alignment: centered icon over centered two-line label
feature_row.data_rule: Render only for verified product attributes/metafields or explicit theme configuration. Never hard-code unsupported claims.

primary_cta.icon: small cart icon left of label
primary_cta.functional_boundary: Presentation does not mandate direct add-to-cart. Required variant, fitment, finish, size, configuration, availability, or product-detail routing remains governed by verified Lumia/Shopify behavior.

secondary_action.label: View Details
secondary_action.hierarchy: tertiary/text action; materially quieter than primary CTA

principles: Preserve a near-square dominant product-media region.
Maintain minimum practical touch targets around wishlist and CTA controls.
Keep taxonomy, title, rating/price readable without horizontal compression.
Allow optional feature row and thumbnail rail to simplify or hide when card width becomes too narrow.
Prefer fewer visible swatches plus +N rather than wrapping multiple swatch rows.
Do not introduce new drawers, hover-only controls, or elaborate mobile interactions.
Respect existing Lumia carousel/grid breakpoints and slide behavior unless implementation verification shows a visual conflict.

suggested_compaction.feature_row: may reduce typography/icon scale or be omitted if configured as nonessential

unknown_shopify_data_dependencies: Swatch option naming, color/image source, and variant interaction
Whether '/ wheel' applies to every product
Rules determining direct add-to-cart versus configuration/product-detail routing
Existing product-card snippet markup and CSS hooks used by Lumia
implementation_agent_verification: Inspect index-product-carousel-tabs and the shared product-card snippet(s) before editing.
Confirm whether the section reuses the same product-card renderer as grid/recommendation contexts.
Map every optional visual region to existing theme settings, product fields, metafields, tags, or verified extensions.
Preserve native carousel breakpoints, pagination/navigation, product URLs, price rendering, variant/cart logic, wishlist logic, and accessibility semantics where available.
Verify equal-height behavior and overflow with realistic Calder titles, prices, swatches, ratings, and missing-data states.
Verify desktop, tablet, and mobile in both carousel and grid contexts.
Treat all mobile dimensions/behavior in this document as assumptions until visually QA'd.

project_context.lumia_carousel: The supplied Lumia products-carousel section renders the shared 'product-card' snippet for multi-product carousel slides and contains responsive Swiper breakpoints.
project_context.lumia_grid: The supplied Lumia products-grid section also renders the shared 'product-card' snippet in its default grid and fixed-banner product-grid modes.
project_context.implication: The existing shared product-card renderer is the first reuse/restyle/extension point to inspect; this does not prescribe final Liquid architecture.
